items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Kirby and I, we did Larry Adler's album

ctx.x: Oh, we wanted to come back first-class, and he helped us get home. Kirby disbanded out there, and the money wasn't too cool, you know -- the money had disappeared! So he gave us (?) to get home.

By this time the record was breaking. Kirby and I, we did Larry Adler's album, and for doing Larry Adler's album they took two numbers, "Mad About You" and "Lover Man." This is while I was in Kirby's...
